The Missing Piece#000.src: Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#002.src: Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! i don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
The Missing Piece#002.dst: 沒看到我在忙嗎！？抽號碼牌然後乖乖排隊，跟大家一樣！我不管現在有沒有別人在，照規矩來！
The Missing Piece#002.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#003.src: Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#003.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的抽號機抽一張號碼牌。

The Missing Piece#004.src: You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
The Missing Piece#004.dst: 你得跟大家一樣抽號碼牌！
The Missing Piece#004.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#005.src: Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#008.src: I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
The Missing Piece#008.dst: 我馬上就來！唉，現在的人怎麼都這麼沒耐性……
The Missing Piece#008.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#009.src: Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
The Missing Piece#009.dst: 這就等不下去了？還不是因為有人趁我不在，把這裡搞得一團亂等我回來收拾！
The Missing Piece#009.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#010.src: I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
The Missing Piece#010.dst: 我昨天才剛從我應得的、短短十八週的假期回到局裡。結果我得到的是什麼？！
The Missing Piece#010.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#011.src: Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
The Missing Piece#011.dst: 你看看我那個代班的把這裡弄成什麼樣子？現在還得我來收拾，不然皇家督察會要我的腦袋！
The Missing Piece#011.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#012.src: I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#012.dst: 我可要告訴你，我是 Aelumia 皇家大學以優異成績畢業的。
The Missing Piece#012.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#013.src: Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
The Missing Piece#013.dst: 老實說，把我丟到這種地方，跟……唉……這些鄉巴佬混在一起，實在太貶低我了！還有那個味道，別逼我開口！
The Missing Piece#013.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#014.src: But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
The Missing Piece#014.dst: 算了，這都不是重點。你剛剛到底要幹嘛？
The Missing Piece#014.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#015.src: It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#015.dst: 是你！我放假時就是把這裡交給你的，你這個混帳！
The Missing Piece#015.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#016.src: I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#016.dst: 我就知道！像我這種大學畢業生怎麼可能會弄錯！
The Missing Piece#016.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#017.src: Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#017.dst: 別想給我打混過去！像我這種大學畢業生怎麼可能會弄錯！
The Missing Piece#017.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#020.src: It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
The Missing Piece#020.dst: 督察來查的時候有麻煩的可不只我一個，這你總該明白吧？
The Missing Piece#020.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#022.src: If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
The Missing Piece#022.dst: 如果你把你捅出來的簍子收拾乾淨……那這件事就沒人會知道。
The Missing Piece#022.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#023.src: You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
The Missing Piece#023.dst: 你不用惹麻煩，皇家督察開心，我也開心。大家都開心！
The Missing Piece#023.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#026.src: Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#026.dst: 那就給我去分信，分得像你這條命靠它一樣，混帳！
The Missing Piece#026.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#027.dst: 因為你這條命真的靠它。
The Missing Piece#027.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#030.src: Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
The Missing Piece#030.dst: 分信簡單得很，連你這種人應該都會。
The Missing Piece#030.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#031.src: All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
The Missing Piece#031.dst: 你只要把包裹從那邊的輸送帶上拿下來。
The Missing Piece#031.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#032.src: And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
The Missing Piece#032.dst: 然後放到那邊它們該去的地方。
The Missing Piece#032.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#033.src: {p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
The Missing Piece#033.dst: {p}的包裹放{p}，Auburn 的包裹放{p}，依此類推。
The Missing Piece#033.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#035.src: Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
The Missing Piece#035.dst: 好極了！別給我搞砸就行，聽到沒？
The Missing Piece#035.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#039.src: Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
The Missing Piece#039.dst: 不過那只是暖身而已！後面還多著呢，別給我摸魚！
The Missing Piece#039.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#040.src: Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
The Missing Piece#040.dst: 嗯……這次你做得還行，不過小心點，最後這批包裹來得很快！
The Missing Piece#040.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#041.src: Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
The Missing Piece#041.dst: 別以為會分幾個包裹就了不起了！
The Missing Piece#041.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#042.src: What are you doing over there!?
The Missing Piece#042.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#043.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#043.dst: 唉！重來一次，這次給我做對！
The Missing Piece#043.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#044.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#044.dst: 唉！重來一次，這次給我做對！
The Missing Piece#044.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#045.src: Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
The Missing Piece#045.dst: 我在工作的時候別來煩我！我上大學可不是為了跟你這種人鬼混！
The Missing Piece#045.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#047.src: Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
The Missing Piece#047.dst: 啊，太好了！你把包裹都分好了！
The Missing Piece#047.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#048.src: But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
The Missing Piece#048.dst: 等等，這是什麼？為什麼有這麼多包裹要寄到{p}？
The Missing Piece#048.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#049.src: Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
The Missing Piece#049.dst: 你是不是分錯了，你這個蠢貨！？
The Missing Piece#049.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#050.src: What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
The Missing Piece#050.dst: 這些包裹是怎麼回事！裡面裝的全是信？
The Missing Piece#050.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#051.src: Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
The Missing Piece#051.dst: 哼……全都寄給山丘上那個女人……天曉得那是什麼意思！
The Missing Piece#051.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#052.src: Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
The Missing Piece#052.dst: 喂，混帳。這也是你的職責，你知道吧！
The Missing Piece#052.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#053.src: Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
The Missing Piece#053.dst: 去把這些信送掉！不然……不然我就跟皇家督察講你幹的好事！沒錯，別跟我作對！
The Missing Piece#053.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#054.src: How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
The Missing Piece#054.dst: 我哪知道！那是你的工作，自己想辦法。你看，上面寫著「給山丘上的女人」，這樣還不夠嗎？
The Missing Piece#054.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#055.src: Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
The Missing Piece#055.dst: 喔，你當然惹得起！我朋友多得很，而且個個位高權重！大學認識的，你給我記牢了！
The Missing Piece#055.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#056.src: Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
The Missing Piece#056.dst: 太好了！這件事解決了，我終於可以回去做我非常重要的工作了。
The Missing Piece#056.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#057.src: Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
The Missing Piece#057.dst: 喔，對，非常重要。大學畢業生，我有提過嗎？
The Missing Piece#057.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#058.src: Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
The Missing Piece#058.dst: 好了好了，快去。要是找不到那個神祕女人，別哭著回來找我！
The Missing Piece#058.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#059.src: But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
The Missing Piece#059.dst: 不過信要是弄丟了我還能再給你一封，那東西好像多到用不完！
The Missing Piece#059.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#060.src: Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#060.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近打聽山丘上的女人。

The Missing Piece#061.src: Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
The Missing Piece#061.dst: 你是想摸魚嗎？信還在你身上，快去送！
The Missing Piece#061.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#063.src: Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
The Missing Piece#063.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#064.src: Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
The Missing Piece#064.dst: 別以為這樣就能脫身！我還有備份！
The Missing Piece#064.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#065.src: Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
The Missing Piece#065.dst: 快去給我把這件事處理好，好嗎？我要煩的事情夠多了，不需要你在這邊亂搞！
The Missing Piece#065.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#067.src: Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
The Missing Piece#067.dst: 找人啊？這一帶會做這種事的，通常是那些鐵罐頭。
The Missing Piece#067.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#068.src: A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
The Missing Piece#068.dst: 被那種東西找上門，你就能享受一趟王室全額招待的假期，懂我意思吧。
The Missing Piece#068.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#069.src: Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
The Missing Piece#069.dst: 老實說，你要找的要是 Lars，我很樂意把他供出來，可惜你還沒說你要找誰。
The Missing Piece#069.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#070.src: PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
The Missing Piece#070.dst: 這一帶山丘多得是，女人也是。不過據我所知她們都在工廠裡做牛做馬，不在什麼山丘上。
The Missing Piece#070.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#071.src: Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
The Missing Piece#071.dst: 抱歉啦老兄，這個我幫不上忙。去問 Lars 吧，他通常都窩在我後面那條巷子裡霸著火堆。真討厭那傢伙……
The Missing Piece#071.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#073.src: Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
The Missing Piece#073.dst: 我不是全都跟你講過了嗎？去煩 Lars 吧，我沒別的好說了。
The Missing Piece#073.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#075.src: I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
The Missing Piece#075.dst: 我在找一個叫「山丘上的女人」的人。我有一封信要送給她。
The Missing Piece#075.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#076.src: A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
The Missing Piece#076.dst: 一封信？山丘上的女人我是不曉得啦，不過那邊那個 Bush 說不定知道。
The Missing Piece#076.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#077.src: He usually knows things... He's a knower.
The Missing Piece#077.dst: 他通常什麼都知道……他是個知道的人。
The Missing Piece#077.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#078.src: Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
The Missing Piece#078.dst: 不過別跟他講太久，不然他會開始往你腦袋裡塞奇怪的東西……
The Missing Piece#078.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#080.src: Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
The Missing Piece#080.dst: 去問 Bush。我說了我什麼都不知道。
The Missing Piece#080.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#081.src: I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
The Missing Piece#081.dst: 我是 Bush，幸會。你有什麼想知道的嗎？
The Missing Piece#081.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#082.src: Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
The Missing Piece#082.dst: 喔，對，她啊……Bush 我可太清楚她了！
The Missing Piece#082.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#083.src: Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
The Missing Piece#083.dst: 沒有她，Bush 早就枯了！沒錯，灌木要有水才長得大。我知道，我知道！
The Missing Piece#083.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#084.src: But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
The Missing Piece#084.dst: 不過首先，我必須知道你為什麼必須知道！你知道嗎？
The Missing Piece#084.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#085.src: A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
The Missing Piece#085.dst: 一封信！要是 Bush 能知道裡面寫什麼就好了……唉，可惜知道了就太失禮了……
The Missing Piece#085.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#086.src: The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
The Missing Piece#086.dst: 送信這一行，真是高尚的職業。我可以告訴你她在哪裡，但作為交換，你必須轉告她：她的朋友回到鎮上了。
The Missing Piece#086.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#087.src: Here, let me write it down for you!
The Missing Piece#087.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#088.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#088.dst: 現在你知道了！現在你知道了！
The Missing Piece#088.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#089.src: To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
The Missing Piece#089.dst: 我為什麼必須知道？連我自己都不知道……我只知道我必須知道！
The Missing Piece#089.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#090.src: Again, tell me why you must know.
The Missing Piece#090.dst: 再說一次，告訴我你為什麼必須知道。
The Missing Piece#090.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#091.src: Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
The Missing Piece#091.dst: 沒有理由？世上竟然有這種人，我以前不知道！現在我知道了，現在我知道了！
The Missing Piece#091.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#093.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#093.dst: 現在你知道了！現在你知道了！
The Missing Piece#093.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#095.src: Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
The Missing Piece#095.dst: 郵件？親愛的，你八成走錯家了。
The Missing Piece#095.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#096.src: No one is sending me any of that...
The Missing Piece#096.dst: 沒有人會寄那種東西給我……
The Missing Piece#096.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#097.src: Well, if it says so on the letter...
The Missing Piece#097.dst: 唉，既然信上是這麼寫的……
The Missing Piece#097.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#098.src: Come in and we'll talk about it.
The Missing Piece#098.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#100.src: I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
The Missing Piece#100.dst: 山丘上這裡不太有客人來的。
The Missing Piece#100.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#105.src: Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#108.src: I think I'll need a closer look at this.
The Missing Piece#108.dst: 我想我得仔細看看這些東西。
The Missing Piece#108.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#109.src: Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
The Missing Piece#109.dst: 請坐吧。我去弄點喝的給你。
The Missing Piece#109.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#111.src: You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
The Missing Piece#111.dst: 你看起來不像這一帶的人，對吧？
The Missing Piece#111.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#112.src: Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#112.dst: 嗯？也罷，我不該打探客人的秘密。解釋不了的事，就讓它擱著吧，哈。你不覺得嗎？
The Missing Piece#112.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#113.src: Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
The Missing Piece#113.dst: 在 Roughworks 這裡，我們沒有秘密。至少女王陛下希望大家這麼相信，哈。
The Missing Piece#113.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#114.src: That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
The Missing Piece#114.dst: 所以我才選擇住在這裡。下面那些住宅區，牆壁比紙還薄。什麼聲音都藏不住。
The Missing Piece#114.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#115.src: Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
The Missing Piece#115.dst: 山丘上這裡就安靜多了。只要水務局不來敲門就好，哈。
The Missing Piece#115.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#116.src: Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
The Missing Piece#116.dst: 既然你都來了，不如聊幾句吧？山丘上可沒什麼人能說話！
The Missing Piece#116.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#117.src: Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#118.src: The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
The Missing Piece#118.dst: 澆水壺就在外面的花園裡。屋裡有三盆，屋外也有三盆。
The Missing Piece#118.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#119.src: Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.
The Missing Piece#119.dst: 趁 Elise 讀信的時候幫她的植物澆水。

The Missing Piece#121.src: Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
The Missing Piece#121.dst: 唉，真是一團亂……想理清這些東西我頭都痛了。
The Missing Piece#121.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#122.src: So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
The Missing Piece#122.dst: 這麼多信，跨了這麼多年……到底是誰會這麼執著地想聯絡我？
The Missing Piece#122.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#123.src: Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
The Missing Piece#123.dst: 嗯？喔，你已經澆完水了？真快！
The Missing Piece#123.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#124.src: Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
The Missing Piece#124.dst: 這樣下去我是不會有什麼進展了，看來我們倆都需要休息一下。
The Missing Piece#124.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#125.src: Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
The Missing Piece#125.dst: 喔，今天天氣真好……不如我們到外面的花園坐一會兒吧？
The Missing Piece#125.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#126.src: Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#126.dst: 跟著 Elise 到外面，在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 坐下。

The Missing Piece#128.src: It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#128.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#129.src: Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
The Missing Piece#129.dst: 啊……剛澆過水的花。沒有什麼味道比得上這個。
The Missing Piece#129.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#130.src: Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
The Missing Piece#130.dst: 嗯。你看到那邊那棵樹了嗎？
The Missing Piece#130.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#131.src: It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
The Missing Piece#131.dst: 整個 Roughworks 就只有這麼一棵。很美吧？
The Missing Piece#131.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#132.src: It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
The Missing Piece#132.dst: 那是別人送的，可是是誰送的……又是一件我忘掉的事。
The Missing Piece#132.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#133.src: It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
The Missing Piece#133.dst: 好不甘心，真的好不甘心……那些珍貴的回憶……
The Missing Piece#133.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#135.src: It isn't much now, that is for certain.
The Missing Piece#135.dst: 現在確實還不怎麼樣，這點沒錯。

The Missing Piece#136.src: Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#136.dst: 嗯。這樣就已經很美了，你不覺得嗎？
The Missing Piece#136.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#138.src: Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
The Missing Piece#138.dst: 哈！它當然會長大，它是樹啊！
The Missing Piece#138.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#139.src: Oh, you know I didn't mean it like that.
The Missing Piece#139.dst: 喔，你知道我不是那個意思。

The Missing Piece#140.src: For each year that passes... this tree will grow taller, and ever more beautiful.
The Missing Piece#140.dst: 每過一年……這棵樹就會長得更高，也更美。

The Missing Piece#141.src: It'll have to weather many storms, and on some days it might even have to go without water. And still, it will continue growing.
The Missing Piece#141.dst: 它得撐過很多場暴風雨，有些日子甚至沒有水喝。即使如此，它還是會繼續長。

The Missing Piece#143.src: And then in ten, fifteen, maybe even twenty-five years... we'll finally be able to rest in its shade.
The Missing Piece#143.dst: 然後再過十年、十五年，也許二十五年……我們終於可以在它的樹蔭下歇息了。

The Missing Piece#144.src: Twenty-five years!? We'll be old by then!
The Missing Piece#144.dst: 二十五年！？到那時候我們都老了！
The Missing Piece#144.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#145.src: Oh, I know! We could have a picnic underneath its canopy Doesn't that sound nice, {u}?
The Missing Piece#145.dst: 喔，我知道了！我們可以在樹蔭底下野餐。聽起來不錯吧，{u}？
The Missing Piece#145.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#146.src: ... It does. It does sound nice, Elise. Perhaps we could.
The Missing Piece#146.dst: ……不錯。聽起來真的不錯，Elise。也許可以。

The Missing Piece#147.src: Go on, give it some more water. Or it'll never grow an inch!
The Missing Piece#147.dst: 去吧，再多澆點水。不然它一吋都長不了！

The Missing Piece#152.src: I was just thinking... If I were to die some day, I'd like to be buried here, under the tree.
The Missing Piece#152.dst: 我只是在想……如果哪天我死了，我想葬在這裡，這棵樹下。

The Missing Piece#153.src: Huh? What could possibly make you think about such silly things? We still have a long life left ahead of us, don't we?
The Missing Piece#153.dst: 咦？你怎麼會想這種傻事？我們的日子還長得很，不是嗎？
The Missing Piece#153.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#154.src: Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, I'm just not used to this...
The Missing Piece#154.dst: 當然，你說得對。抱歉，我只是還不習慣……

The Missing Piece#157.src: Let's just enjoy the sun, for a bit. There's still work tomorrow.
The Missing Piece#157.dst: 我們就這樣曬一會兒太陽吧。明天還要上工呢。
The Missing Piece#157.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#160.src: Hm. I shall leave the worrying for another day, I think. Today is a good day... not a day for worrying.
The Missing Piece#160.dst: 嗯。我想這些煩惱還是留到別天再說吧。今天是個好日子……不是拿來煩惱的日子。
The Missing Piece#160.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#161.src: In fact, today is too nice a day to waste it... by not going anywhere, that is. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#161.dst: 而且今天天氣這麼好，不出門走走就太浪費了，你不覺得嗎？
The Missing Piece#161.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#163.src: Follow Elise to the roof at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#163.dst: 跟著 Elise 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的屋頂。

The Missing Piece#164.src: Ah... Do you see that factory off that way? I used to work there, back when I was younger...
The Missing Piece#164.dst: 啊……你看到那邊那間工廠了嗎？我年輕的時候在那裡做過……
The Missing Piece#164.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#165.src: We mass-produced bread for the higher regions... Tedious work, and thankless too.
The Missing Piece#165.dst: 我們大量生產麵包送到上面那些區域……乏味的工作，而且沒人感激。
The Missing Piece#165.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#166.src: I'm sure you have noticed, but things around here aren't too easy. Some people even go as far as stealing when times are tough...
The Missing Piece#166.dst: 你應該也注意到了，這一帶的日子不好過。日子難過的時候，有些人甚至會去偷……
The Missing Piece#166.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#167.src: Fortunately... I never had to. They would let us take some home, every once in a while.
The Missing Piece#167.dst: 幸好……我從來不必那麼做。他們偶爾會讓我們帶一點回家。
The Missing Piece#167.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#168.src: Those were good days. On those occasions, we'd go and have ourselves a picnic, me and- hm. Just me, I suppose.
The Missing Piece#168.dst: 那是好日子。遇到那種時候，我們就會去野餐，我跟——嗯。我想，就只有我吧。
The Missing Piece#168.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#169.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure!
The Missing Piece#169.dst: 可惜現在很難弄到了……偷竊真的變成一個大問題，你知道嗎。王室最後在工廠底下蓋了一座金庫，把東西全鎖起來！
The Missing Piece#169.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#170.src: How long, since I last had some? Years, surely... not like any of that bread ever makes it to us poor folk, ha!
The Missing Piece#170.dst: 我上次吃到是多久以前了？肯定好幾年了……反正那些麵包也輪不到我們這些窮人，哈！
The Missing Piece#170.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#171.src: But it'd be nice to have some again, I suppose... reminisce on old times.
The Missing Piece#171.dst: 不過要是能再吃到一次也不錯……回味一下從前。
The Missing Piece#171.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#172.src: Well, if you're running errands for me already... mind seeing if you can get your hands on a loaf or two?
The Missing Piece#172.dst: 既然你都在幫我跑腿了……能不能順便看看弄不弄得到一兩條？
The Missing Piece#172.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#173.src: It's expensive, but for the right price... I'm sure you could get ahold of some. You don't seem the sort to struggle with that kind of thing, do you, letter carrier?
The Missing Piece#173.dst: 那很貴，不過只要價錢對……我相信你弄得到。你看起來不像會為這種事傷腦筋的人，送信的，對吧？
The Missing Piece#173.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#174.src: Ha! Well, do your best, either way. Once you come back, I have a plan for what we can do today. How's that sound?
The Missing Piece#174.dst: 哈！總之盡力吧。等你回來，我想好今天可以做什麼了。你覺得如何？
The Missing Piece#174.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#175.src: Try to enter the Bread Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#176.src: Oh, no... You know! You know! Speak to that constable first, and perhaps, I'll tell you more.
The Missing Piece#176.dst: 喔，不……你知道！你知道！先去跟那個警備說話，也許我會告訴你更多。
The Missing Piece#176.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#177.src: If you've come to beg, you might as well leave.
The Missing Piece#177.dst: 你要是來討飯的，那就趁早走人。
The Missing Piece#177.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#178.src: Huh? Alright, bud. We all do.
The Missing Piece#178.dst: 咦？好吧，老兄。我們都一樣。
The Missing Piece#178.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#180.src: Do I look like a vending machine to you? Go find somewhere else. We just make bread here, we don't sell it.
The Missing Piece#180.dst: 我看起來像販賣機嗎？去別的地方找。我們這裡只做麵包，不賣麵包。
The Missing Piece#180.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#181.src: Get out of here pal, you shouldn't be loitering around under a Constable's watch.
The Missing Piece#181.dst: 走開吧老兄，警備看著呢，你不該在這裡閒晃。
The Missing Piece#181.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#182.src: But, but, but! No buts. Don't make me have to do something! The paperwork is always such a hassle...
The Missing Piece#182.dst: 可是、可是、可是！沒有可是。別逼我出手！那些文書工作麻煩死了……
The Missing Piece#182.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#184.src: Obviously not... We have enough problems as it is, what with that stolen barrel last week... And the production quotas...
The Missing Piece#184.dst: 當然不行……我們的麻煩已經夠多了，上禮拜還被偷了一桶……還有產量指標……
The Missing Piece#184.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#185.src: Don't you have something better to do anyway?
The Missing Piece#185.dst: 你就沒有別的事情好做嗎？
The Missing Piece#185.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#187.src: Over here, friend of a friend!

The Missing Piece#189.src: Did you know? Did you know? There is more than one way to enter any building.
The Missing Piece#189.dst: 你知道嗎？你知道嗎？進一棟建築的方法從來不只一種。
The Missing Piece#189.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#190.src: I'll tell you! But, stealing is unethical, you must know!
The Missing Piece#190.dst: 我會告訴你！不過偷竊是不道德的，這你必須知道！
The Missing Piece#190.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#191.src: As long as she doesn't know! She won't know! Do you understand?
The Missing Piece#191.dst: 只要她不知道！她就不會知道！你明白嗎？
The Missing Piece#191.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#192.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#192.dst: 就在轉角那裡，你看。一根管子！現在你知道了！現在你知道了！
The Missing Piece#192.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#193.src: Enter the Bread Factory through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#194.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#194.dst: 就在轉角那裡，你看。一根管子！現在你知道了！現在你知道了！
The Missing Piece#194.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#196.src: Find a way to enter the Bread Vault through the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#196.dst: 想辦法從 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的電梯進入麵包金庫。

The Missing Piece#199.src: Uhh? That's not an answer! Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#199.dst: 呃？這算什麼回答！快說你是誰，不然我自己過去看！我可是過目不忘的，你給我記住！
The Missing Piece#199.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#200.src: What's a worker doing in my office!? Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#200.dst: 一個工人跑到我辦公室裡幹什麼！？快說你是誰，不然我自己過去看！我可是過目不忘的，你給我記住！
The Missing Piece#200.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#202.src: Well, thank you for bringing this to my attention! I will investigate the matter immediately!
The Missing Piece#202.dst: 好，謝謝你告訴我！我立刻去查！
The Missing Piece#202.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#204.src: Make your way through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#206.src: Hit the bottles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with a Bottle.

The Missing Piece#207.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#208.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#210.src: ...and in accordance with our protocols, we will require a detailed record of this former employee. Years of employment, known associates, work performance... all of it.
The Missing Piece#210.dst: ……依照我們的規程，我們需要這名前員工的詳細紀錄。任職年限、已知的往來對象、工作表現……全部都要。
The Missing Piece#210.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#211.src: Naturally, I will comply to the best of my ability, blessed be Her Grace. But to think that the mere theft of one crate would reach this high a level...
The Missing Piece#211.dst: 我自然會全力配合，願陛下蒙福。只是沒想到區區一箱失竊的貨，竟會驚動到這種層級……
The Missing Piece#211.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#212.src: The crate is not relevant. It is the employee who is of interest. Further measures may be necessary, but the records will do well to begin with.
The Missing Piece#212.dst: 那箱貨不重要。我們感興趣的是那名員工。後續可能還會有進一步的措施，不過先從紀錄開始就好。
The Missing Piece#212.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#213.src: ...only the employee? Pardon my questions, but I do not understand why she is of interest to you.
The Missing Piece#213.dst: ……只要那名員工？恕我多問，我不明白她為什麼會引起你們的興趣。
The Missing Piece#213.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#214.src: That is for us to know, and for you to comply. But it pertains to a potential security breach which we are investigating.
The Missing Piece#214.dst: 那是我們該知道、你只需配合的事。不過這牽涉到我們正在調查的一起可能的保安漏洞。
The Missing Piece#214.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#215.src: At my factory? What are you implying!?
The Missing Piece#215.dst: 在我的工廠？你這是什麼意思！？
The Missing Piece#215.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#216.src: I imply nothing. Must you be reminded of your position? It is by Her Majesty's will that I am here today. Do you truly wish to stand against it?
The Missing Piece#216.dst: 我沒有任何暗示。需要我提醒你自己的身分嗎？我今天站在這裡是奉女王陛下之意。你真的想與之對抗嗎？
The Missing Piece#216.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#217.src: I... I humbly apologize... I didn't mean-
The Missing Piece#217.dst: 我……我謙卑地致歉……我不是那個意思——
The Missing Piece#217.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#219.src: Y-yes, of course. But, still, I had thought that matter was settled years ago! What connection could it possibly have to-
The Missing Piece#219.dst: 是、是，當然。可是，那件事我原以為多年前就了結了！那跟——
The Missing Piece#219.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#220.src: Enough aimless rambling. My time is limited. Pull up those records on this Elise, immediately.
The Missing Piece#220.dst: 無謂的贅述到此為止。我的時間有限。立刻把這個叫 Elise 的紀錄調出來。
The Missing Piece#220.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#221.src: U-understood, ma'am... I'll get them right away.
The Missing Piece#221.dst: 明、明白了，長官……我馬上去拿。
The Missing Piece#221.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#222.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#223.src: Acquire the bread from the barrel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#224.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#225.src: Find the way out of the Bread Vault at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#226.src: Well, well, well... it would seem the rats aren't the only plague to infest this place.
The Missing Piece#226.dst: 哎呀呀……看來這地方鬧的不只是老鼠。
The Missing Piece#226.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#227.src: And here I had thought this particular lead was dead end! Only years-old records which tell us nothing we did not already know... always a risk, but worth checking regardless.
The Missing Piece#227.dst: 我原本還以為這條線索斷了呢！只有一堆陳年紀錄，說的全是我們早就知道的事……本來就有風險，不過還是值得查一查。
The Missing Piece#227.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#228.src: But here you are. One of the province's most wanted criminals. What a strange coincidence, finding you here.
The Missing Piece#228.dst: 沒想到你在這裡。全境通緝的要犯之一。在這裡遇到你，真是奇妙的巧合。
The Missing Piece#228.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#229.src: I must wonder... for what reason are you here?
The Missing Piece#229.dst: 我倒是很好奇……你來這裡是為了什麼？
The Missing Piece#229.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#230.src: I know better than to expect an answer. But it does not matter, in the end. We will get it out of you eventually.
The Missing Piece#230.dst: 我沒指望你會回答。不過那不重要，到頭來我們遲早會從你嘴裡撬出來。
The Missing Piece#230.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#234.src: Return to the Roughworks through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#234.dst: 從 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的管子回到 Roughworks。

The Missing Piece#236.src: Confront the inspection or talk to Elise at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#236.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 面對稽查隊，或是和 Elise 說話。

The Missing Piece#237.src: Oh, it's the Water Authority! I don't know why they're here... but it can't be for any good reason.
The Missing Piece#237.dst: 喔，是水務局！我不知道他們來做什麼……但肯定不是好事。
The Missing Piece#237.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#238.src: Open up already! We know you're in there!
The Missing Piece#238.dst: 快開門！我們知道你在裡面！
The Missing Piece#238.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#239.src: Really, you should hide. It's okay, I've dealt with their type before. I'll send them away.
The Missing Piece#239.dst: 說真的，你該躲起來。沒事的，這種人我以前應付過。我會把他們打發走。
The Missing Piece#239.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#241.src: Good. Quick, find somewhere to hide!
The Missing Piece#241.dst: 很好。快，找個地方躲起來！
The Missing Piece#241.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#242.src: Wait one second! I'll hide behind the plant!
The Missing Piece#242.dst: 等一下！我躲到植物後面！
The Missing Piece#242.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#246.src: A friend, you say? Then you should be able to tell me why she's not answering the door!
The Missing Piece#246.dst: 你說是朋友？那你應該說得出她為什麼不來開門！
The Missing Piece#246.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#248.src: Someone like me!? What's that supposed to mean?
The Missing Piece#248.dst: 像我這種人！？你這話是什麼意思？
The Missing Piece#248.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#249.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#249.dst: 喔，你會為這句侮辱付出代價！我們有權以武力執行命令，你知道吧！我們想做什麼都可以！
The Missing Piece#249.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#250.src: Not at home, you say? How convenient. Just as the inspection comes around they're not at home to greet us!
The Missing Piece#250.dst: 你說不在家？真是巧啊。剛好稽查來的時候人就不在家迎接我們！
The Missing Piece#250.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#251.src: It's almost like someone tipped them off, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#251.dst: 簡直像是有人通風報信，你不覺得嗎？
The Missing Piece#251.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#252.src: Say friend, did you tip off the subject that we were coming?
The Missing Piece#252.dst: 說吧朋友，是不是你去通知對方我們要來的？
The Missing Piece#252.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#253.src: Very well, then. But we will still need to get in to conduct the search.
The Missing Piece#253.dst: 那好吧。不過我們還是得進去執行搜查。
The Missing Piece#253.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#254.src: If you won't be of any use, then you better get out of our way!
The Missing Piece#254.dst: 你要是幫不上忙，那就給我讓開！
The Missing Piece#254.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#255.src: At the bread factory? That's none of our concern, we're the Water Authority, not the Bread Authority!
The Missing Piece#255.dst: 在麵包工廠？那不關我們的事，我們是水務局，不是麵包局！
The Missing Piece#255.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#256.src: A massive water spillage, you say!?
The Missing Piece#256.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#257.src: And you're not making this up? We don't take easily to liars, you should know.
The Missing Piece#257.dst: 你不是在編故事吧？我們可不喜歡騙子，你最好知道。
The Missing Piece#257.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#258.src: Inspector, there seems to be some commotion coming from the Bread Factory.
The Missing Piece#258.dst: 督察，麵包工廠那邊好像有騷動。
The Missing Piece#258.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#259.src: Hmm... Well, in that case, we'll have to check it out. Thank you for the information, citizen.
The Missing Piece#259.dst: 嗯……那樣的話，我們得去看看。謝謝你提供消息，市民。
The Missing Piece#259.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#260.src: Passing by! As if! Did you really think I would believe that story?
The Missing Piece#260.dst: 路過！才怪！你真以為我會信這種說詞？
The Missing Piece#260.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#261.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#261.dst: 喔，你會為這句侮辱付出代價！我們有權以武力執行命令，你知道吧！我們想做什麼都可以！
The Missing Piece#261.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#262.src: We are here to execute a search. Your water usage levels have exceeded your authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#262.dst: 我們是來執行搜查的。你的用水量已經超過核准的配額。
The Missing Piece#262.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#265.src: Very well. We will now conduct an inspection of your property. Step out of the way, subject.
The Missing Piece#265.dst: 很好。我們現在要對你的住所進行稽查。讓開，臣民。
The Missing Piece#265.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#266.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#266.dst: 這是什麼？難怪你的用水量會超標，原來私藏了違禁植物！
The Missing Piece#266.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#267.src: Wait a second... There's someone hiding behind there! You said you were alone!
The Missing Piece#267.dst: 等一下……那後面有人躲著！你說你是一個人的！
The Missing Piece#267.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#268.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#268.dst: 喔，你會為這句侮辱付出代價！我們有權以武力執行命令，你知道吧！我們想做什麼都可以！
The Missing Piece#268.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#272.src: Noooooooo, Alphonse! How... How could you do this!?
The Missing Piece#272.dst: 不不不不不，Alphonse！你……你怎麼可以這樣！？
The Missing Piece#272.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#273.src: You'll pay for this, you rat! In the name of Her Majesty!
The Missing Piece#273.dst: 你會為此付出代價的，你這隻老鼠！以女王陛下之名！
The Missing Piece#273.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#274.src: Are you alright!? I heard a commotion, and
The Missing Piece#274.dst: 你還好嗎！？我聽到一陣騷動，然後
The Missing Piece#274.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#276.src: You may as well come inside, dearie.
The Missing Piece#276.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#278.src: But how strange... The authorities have never bothered me before... Oh, let's just get inside for now.
The Missing Piece#278.dst: 不過真奇怪……當局從來沒有找過我的麻煩……唉，總之先進屋再說。
The Missing Piece#278.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#279.src: Find somewhere to hide in Elise's house!
The Missing Piece#279.dst: 在 Elise 家裡找個地方躲起來！

The Missing Piece#282.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#282.dst: 好了。那麼，女王陛下的當局找我這個老太婆能有什麼事呢？
The Missing Piece#282.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#283.src: We are here to execute a search. You water usage levels have exceeded you authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#283.dst: 我們是來執行搜查的。你的用水量已經超過核准的配額。
The Missing Piece#283.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#288.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#288.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#289.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#289.dst: 我問你，你希望我們先搜下面還是上面？
The Missing Piece#289.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#290.src: How kind of you to ask... but as there is nothing of interest anywhere, I would suggest you start by finding a reason to get out of my home.
The Missing Piece#290.dst: 你真客氣……不過反正哪裡都沒有什麼值得看的，我建議你們先找個理由離開我家。
The Missing Piece#290.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#291.src: I wouldn't want to waste your time, is all.
The Missing Piece#291.dst: 我只是不想浪費你們的時間。
The Missing Piece#291.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#292.src: The lower floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#292.dst: 那就先下面。謝謝你的配合。
The Missing Piece#292.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#295.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#295.dst: 這是什麼？難怪你的用水量會超標，原來私藏了違禁植物！
The Missing Piece#295.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#296.src: Oh what's the matter with you!?
The Missing Piece#296.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#297.src: I've worked my whole life in the factories! Can't I have some flowers to keep me company in my old age?
The Missing Piece#297.dst: 我在工廠做了一輩子！老了養幾盆花陪我不行嗎？
The Missing Piece#297.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#298.src: Inspector. A message from the Authority.
The Missing Piece#298.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#302.dst: 好了。那麼，女王陛下的當局找我這個老太婆能有什麼事呢？

The Missing Piece#309.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#310.src: How kind of you to ask... but as the upper floor is my bedroom, I would prefer it if you didn't inspect my bedsheets.
The Missing Piece#310.dst: 你真客氣……不過樓上是我的臥室，我希望你們不要去翻我的床單。
The Missing Piece#310.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#311.src: The upper floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#311.dst: 那就先上面。謝謝你的配合。
The Missing Piece#311.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#316.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#317.src: How quaint. Doesn't it get lonely, living up here all by your lonesome?
The Missing Piece#317.dst: 真是別緻。一個人住在這種地方，不會寂寞嗎？
The Missing Piece#317.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#319.src: Anyhow, I am required to inform you that you are in breach of the ordinance on water usage and will have to-
The Missing Piece#319.dst: 總之，我必須通知你，你已違反用水條例，將必須——
The Missing Piece#319.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#320.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#331.dst: 我問你，你希望我們先搜下面還是上面？
The Missing Piece#331.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#333.src: Well, seems you're in luck this time, subject.
The Missing Piece#333.dst: 看來你這次走運了，臣民。
The Missing Piece#333.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#334.src: Some higher authority has overruled our command... we're being recalled.
The Missing Piece#334.dst: 上頭有更高的權力推翻了我們的命令……我們被召回了。
The Missing Piece#334.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#335.src: But don't be mistaken. We'll be back!
The Missing Piece#335.dst: 不過別搞錯了。我們還會再來的！
The Missing Piece#335.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#336.src: Well, you won't be welcome next time!
The Missing Piece#336.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#337.src: Nuisances, all of them... Well, it worked out in the end, didn't it?
The Missing Piece#337.dst: 一群討厭鬼……唉，總算是解決了，不是嗎？
The Missing Piece#337.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#338.src: They're gone, you can come out now.
The Missing Piece#338.dst: 他們走了，你可以出來了。
The Missing Piece#338.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#339.src: Come, let's sit down and have a talk.
The Missing Piece#339.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#342.src: Right! The bread! So forgetful these days...
The Missing Piece#342.dst: 對了！麵包！我最近真是健忘……
The Missing Piece#342.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#343.src: Well? How did it go? Did you get any? I hope it wasn't too much trouble...
The Missing Piece#343.dst: 怎麼樣？順利嗎？弄到了嗎？希望沒給你添太多麻煩……
The Missing Piece#343.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#344.src: Oh, wonderful. Thank you. That should be everything we need...
The Missing Piece#344.dst: 喔，太好了。謝謝你。這樣該有的都有了……
The Missing Piece#344.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#345.src: Well, if there was no other way... If the Authority is going to stomp in here looking for plants, taking a loaf of bread in return seems like a fair deal!
The Missing Piece#345.dst: 唉，既然沒有別的辦法……當局都能踏進這裡來找植物了，拿一條麵包當回禮好像也算公平！
The Missing Piece#345.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#347.src: Ah... How nostalgic. It really does bring me back to those good old days.
The Missing Piece#347.dst: 啊……真懷念。真的讓我回到了從前那些好日子。
The Missing Piece#347.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#348.src: There was one time though... We... No, I bought it... Argh, why can't I remember!
The Missing Piece#348.dst: 不過有一次……我們……不對，是我自己買的……啊，我為什麼想不起來！
The Missing Piece#348.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#349.src: How strange... Again, this feeling... As if- as if there's something I should be remembering... but can't.
The Missing Piece#349.dst: 好奇怪……又來了，這種感覺……好像——好像有什麼我應該記得的事……卻想不起來。
The Missing Piece#349.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#350.dst: 要是我能想起來就好了……
The Missing Piece#350.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#351.src: Do you remember how we first me? All those years ago?
The Missing Piece#351.dst: 你還記得我們第一次見面嗎？那麼多年前的事了。

The Missing Piece#352.src: Of course I do! But... thinking about it now, maybe I was a bit... cold.
The Missing Piece#352.dst: 我當然記得！不過……現在想想，我那時候可能有點……冷淡。
The Missing Piece#352.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#353.src: You were fine! You were the only one who...

The Missing Piece#355.src: You were the only one who even noticed I was there.
The Missing Piece#355.dst: 你是唯一一個注意到我在那裡的人。

The Missing Piece#356.src: Ah- hello. I'm {u}, I'm new here. Nice to meet you.
The Missing Piece#356.dst: 啊——你好。我是 {u}，我是新來的。幸會。

The Missing Piece#357.src: The name's Elise, do a good job and I'm sure we'll get along.
The Missing Piece#357.dst: 我叫 Elise，好好做事，我們一定處得來。
The Missing Piece#357.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#358.src: Right, yes. Of course... I'll try my best!

The Missing Piece#359.src: ... You know what, have this. It'll help you get through the day.
The Missing Piece#359.dst: ……這樣吧，這個給你。撐過今天會輕鬆一點。
The Missing Piece#359.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#363.src: Really? I was only working there for a month!
The Missing Piece#363.dst: 真的嗎？我在那裡才做了一個月！

The Missing Piece#364.src: Oh, sure... but it was a good month, wasn't it?
The Missing Piece#364.dst: 喔，是啊……但那是很好的一個月，不是嗎？
The Missing Piece#364.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#365.src: And even after you were transferred away... I had something to look forward to at the end of my shifts.
The Missing Piece#365.dst: 而且就算你後來被調走了……我下班以後也總算有個盼頭。
The Missing Piece#365.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#366.src: Ah... well... now you have something to look forward to when you come home, as well.
The Missing Piece#366.dst: 啊……這個嘛……現在你回到家也有個盼頭了。

The Missing Piece#367.src: Ha! I guess I do, don't I...
The Missing Piece#367.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#368.src: But it all seems so small from up here... doesn't it? Just look at the view!
The Missing Piece#368.dst: 不過從這上面看下去，一切都好小……對吧？你看這片景色！
The Missing Piece#368.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#369.src: It really is beautiful... up here, it's like nothing else matters except for us.
The Missing Piece#369.dst: 真的很美……在這上面，好像除了我們以外什麼都不重要了。

The Missing Piece#370.src: ...I wish we could stay like this forever...
The Missing Piece#370.dst: ……真希望我們可以永遠這樣下去……
The Missing Piece#370.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#371.src: ...oh. So do I, Elise... so do I...

The Missing Piece#372.src: Ha, but why do you sound so sad?
The Missing Piece#372.dst: 哈，可是你的聲音怎麼這麼難過？
The Missing Piece#372.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#374.src: It's nothing... we'll stay like this... forever. I promise.
The Missing Piece#374.dst: 沒事……我們會一直這樣下去的……永遠。我保證。

The Missing Piece#375.src: Her, again... Who is she? Why am I remembering these things?
The Missing Piece#375.dst: 又是她……她是誰？我為什麼會想起這些事？
The Missing Piece#375.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#377.src: Well, there's nothing that can be done about it now, is there? Say, why don't we head out?
The Missing Piece#377.dst: 唉，事到如今也無可奈何了，不是嗎？我說，我們出門走走吧？
The Missing Piece#377.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#378.src: Oh, dear. Did I forget to tell you? The bread is for a picnic!
The Missing Piece#378.dst: 喔，親愛的。我是不是忘了跟你說？麵包是要拿去野餐的！
The Missing Piece#378.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#379.src: I know the perfect place... in fact, you reminded me of it. It has a view over the entire Roughworks, can you believe that?
The Missing Piece#379.dst: 我知道一個絕佳的地方……其實是你讓我想起來的。那裡可以俯瞰整個 Roughworks，你信嗎？
The Missing Piece#379.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#380.src: Although... thinking about it, it's abit far... I don't know if my old legs will carry me all the way there, ha!
The Missing Piece#380.dst: 不過……想想看，那裡有點遠……我這雙老腿不知道走不走得到，哈！
The Missing Piece#380.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#381.dst: 真的嗎？喔，那太謝謝你了！
The Missing Piece#381.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#382.src: Well, what do you say, then? Just talk to me when you want to head out.
The Missing Piece#382.dst: 那麼你覺得如何？想出發的時候再跟我說一聲就好。
The Missing Piece#382.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#384.src: Well, what do you say? Shall we head out?
The Missing Piece#384.dst: 那麼你覺得如何？我們出發吧？
The Missing Piece#384.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#387.src: Oh, you can really see a lot from up here... Let's go!
The Missing Piece#387.dst: 喔，從這上面看得到好多東西……走吧！
The Missing Piece#387.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#388.src: Where to? I know just the place for this! Let's see, it's...
The Missing Piece#388.dst: 往哪走呢？我知道一個正好合適的地方！我想想，是……
The Missing Piece#388.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#389.src: Hm... I think... Forward! Yes, I think it was straight forward from here. Although, my memory might be a little hazy...
The Missing Piece#389.dst: 嗯……我想……往前！對，我想是從這裡一直往前。不過我的記性可能有點模糊……
The Missing Piece#389.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#391.src: Ah, hm... I think we turn left here...
The Missing Piece#391.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#392.src: No, wait... It's right, we definitely have to turn right!
The Missing Piece#392.dst: 不對，等等……是右邊，一定要右轉！
The Missing Piece#392.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#394.src: That house feels familiar... I think... yes, turn right here!
The Missing Piece#394.dst: 那間房子感覺很眼熟……我想……對，這裡右轉！
The Missing Piece#394.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#396.src: Stop! Hmm... I don't think it's across this bridge, at least. Then that must mean...
The Missing Piece#396.dst: 停！嗯……至少我覺得不是過這座橋。那就表示……
The Missing Piece#396.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#397.src: Oh, what's the matter! We'll find it eventually, right? I'm pretty sure it's to the left!
The Missing Piece#397.dst: 唉，怎麼了嘛！我們總會找到的，對吧？我很確定是往左！
The Missing Piece#397.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#399.src: Yes, this is it! It's just around this corner, I'm sure of it!
The Missing Piece#399.dst: 對，就是這裡！就在這個轉角過去，我很確定！
The Missing Piece#399.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#401.src: Here! I remember now... it's in here!
The Missing Piece#401.dst: 這裡！我想起來了……就在這裡面！
The Missing Piece#401.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#402.src: I don't remember it being so overgrown, though...
The Missing Piece#402.dst: 不過我不記得它以前這麼多雜草……
The Missing Piece#402.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#403.src: How long has it been? I can't recall the last time I was here...
The Missing Piece#403.dst: 多久了呢？我不記得上次來是什麼時候了……
The Missing Piece#403.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#405.src: Ah, it's blocked... Well. I didn't want to bring it up, but it seems we're out of options.
The Missing Piece#405.dst: 啊，被擋住了……唉。我本來不想提的，不過看來我們沒別的辦法了。
The Missing Piece#405.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#406.src: Oh, there's no need to pretend anymore. I know what you are. You're one of them, aren't you?
The Missing Piece#406.dst: 喔，不用再裝了。我知道你是什麼。你是他們的一員，對吧？
The Missing Piece#406.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#407.src: The cursed, as the Crown calls them. Not that I care!
The Missing Piece#407.dst: 受詛者，王室是這麼叫的。不過我才不在乎！
The Missing Piece#407.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#408.src: Why should I? I'm old! I have enough to worry about as is...
The Missing Piece#408.dst: 我為什麼要在乎？我都這把年紀了！要煩的事情夠多了……
The Missing Piece#408.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#409.src: Besides, it's certainly useful in situations like this, isn't it? Be a dearie and do one of your little tricks, won't you?
The Missing Piece#409.dst: 而且，這種時候不是很有用嗎？親愛的，行行好，露一手你們的小把戲吧？
The Missing Piece#409.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#411.src: That's it... Let me down now, I can walk the rest of the way myself.
The Missing Piece#411.dst: 就是這樣……放我下來吧，剩下的路我自己走。
The Missing Piece#411.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#413.src: It's a little more... well, deserted, than I remember. But that's fine.
The Missing Piece#413.dst: 這裡比我記得的……嗯，荒涼了一點。不過沒關係。
The Missing Piece#413.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#414.src: We can take this elevator to the top. You'll have to find a way into the control room though... It shouldn't be too hard to reach!
The Missing Piece#414.dst: 我們可以搭這台電梯上去。不過你得想辦法進到控制室……應該不難才對！
The Missing Piece#414.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#415.src: It's that thing over there. The tunnel on the right will get you to it.
The Missing Piece#415.dst: 就是那邊那個東西。右邊那條通道可以通到那裡。
The Missing Piece#415.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#417.src: Can you hear me? I'm down here!
The Missing Piece#417.dst: 聽得到我說話嗎？我在下面！
The Missing Piece#417.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#418.src: Use the controls to get me up! You know how it works, right?
The Missing Piece#418.dst: 用那些控制裝置把我送上來！你知道怎麼操作吧？
The Missing Piece#418.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#419.src: Use the controls at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to bring Elise up.
The Missing Piece#419.dst: 使用 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的控制裝置把 Elise 送上來。

The Missing Piece#422.src: Maybe if... oh, I know. Put something on the up button, then you can clear the blockage... and we'll go up.
The Missing Piece#422.dst: 或許可以……喔，我知道了。在上升鈕上壓個東西，然後你就可以去把卡住的東西清掉……我們就上得去了。
The Missing Piece#422.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#423.src: Perfect! Now it will move, if only we can get it unstuck...
The Missing Piece#423.dst: 太好了！這樣它就會動了，只要能把卡住的地方弄開……
The Missing Piece#423.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#424.src: If you could get up there, somehow...
The Missing Piece#424.dst: 你要是有辦法上去那邊的話……
The Missing Piece#424.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#426.src: Oh well, this place seems abandoned anyhow! Who cares about a little destruction?
The Missing Piece#426.dst: 唉，反正這地方看起來也廢棄了！稍微破壞一下有什麼關係？
The Missing Piece#426.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#427.src: Go up there and see if you can find a way to get this thing going again.
The Missing Piece#427.dst: 上去那邊看看，能不能想辦法讓這東西重新動起來。
The Missing Piece#427.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#429.src: Throw a brick at the blockage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#430.src: How's it going? Can you see anything?
The Missing Piece#430.dst: 情況怎麼樣？看得到什麼嗎？
The Missing Piece#430.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#437.src: Follow Elise to the cliff at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#437.dst: 跟著 Elise 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的崖邊。

The Missing Piece#438.src: Ah, isn't this place nice. The breeze, the view, everything.
The Missing Piece#438.dst: 啊，這地方真好。微風、景色，什麼都好。
The Missing Piece#438.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#439.src: You can even see the trees of the {p} swaying from up here...
The Missing Piece#439.dst: 從這上面甚至看得到{p}的樹在搖曳……
The Missing Piece#439.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#440.src: And finally! A place to sit! I'm sorely in need of some relaxation after this eventful day.
The Missing Piece#440.dst: 而且終於！有地方可以坐了！忙了這麼精彩的一天，我實在需要放鬆一下。
The Missing Piece#440.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#441.src: Please, let's sit down and enjoy the view for a bit.
The Missing Piece#441.dst: 來，我們坐下來欣賞一會兒風景吧。
The Missing Piece#441.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#443.src: Hm. It's strange. All day, I've been... reminiscing, I suppose. And now, seeing this view... it fills me with that same nostalgic feeling.
The Missing Piece#443.dst: 嗯。好奇怪。這一整天，我一直在……回想，我想是吧。現在看著這片景色……又是同樣那股懷念的感覺。
The Missing Piece#443.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#444.src: All day, I've been having these visions of the past. Of these things I can't recall ever happening.
The Missing Piece#444.dst: 這一整天，我一直看見過去的畫面。那些我不記得發生過的事。
The Missing Piece#444.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#445.src: And I... well, truthfully, I'm not sure how to feel about it...
The Missing Piece#445.dst: 而我……老實說，我不知道該怎麼看待這件事……
The Missing Piece#445.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#446.src: But I know- I know in my heart, that there's something missing... a piece that would make it all fit.
The Missing Piece#446.dst: 但我知道——我心裡知道，有什麼東西不見了……少了那一塊，一切就拼不起來。
The Missing Piece#446.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#448.src: In every dream she's there beside me... but I don't even remember her name. I can't even recall her face...
The Missing Piece#448.dst: 每一個夢裡她都在我身邊……可是我連她的名字都不記得。我連她的臉都想不起來……
The Missing Piece#448.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#449.src: If she was this important to me... then how could I forget?
The Missing Piece#449.dst: 如果她對我這麼重要……那我怎麼可能忘記？
The Missing Piece#449.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#452.src: Hurgh... hurgh... One second, I need to catch my breath.
The Missing Piece#452.dst: 呼……呼……等一下，我得喘口氣。
The Missing Piece#452.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#453.src: Hm... Do you know this person? They're not an inspector... are they?
The Missing Piece#453.dst: 嗯……你認識這個人嗎？他該不會是督察吧……？
The Missing Piece#453.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#454.src: So, as I was going to say-
The Missing Piece#454.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#455.src: Okay, fine! I'll get straight to the point.
The Missing Piece#455.dst: 好啦好啦！我直接講重點。
The Missing Piece#455.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#456.src: I found more letters to deliver, and I was on my way to deliver them when I saw you two running out! Can you imagine how shocked I was?
The Missing Piece#456.dst: 我又找到一些要送的信，正要拿去送的時候看到你們兩個跑出來！你能想像我有多震驚嗎？
The Missing Piece#456.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#457.src: That being that, I naturally decided to follow you, the good postmaster that I am. You sure didn't make it easy though! I barely managed to make it up here... It's a nice spot, by the way.
The Missing Piece#457.dst: 既然如此，身為一個稱職的郵政局長，我當然決定跟上來。你們可真不好跟！我差點爬不上來……順帶一提，這地方不錯。
The Missing Piece#457.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#458.src: But... how could you have possibly made it up here...?
The Missing Piece#458.dst: 可是……你到底是怎麼上來的……？
The Missing Piece#458.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#459.src: Getting up here is nothing to a university graduate like me!
The Missing Piece#459.dst: 對我這種大學畢業生來說，爬上來根本不算什麼！
The Missing Piece#459.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#462.src: Well, that was all that I came for I suppose. So...
The Missing Piece#462.dst: 好了，我要做的大概就這些。那麼……
The Missing Piece#462.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#463.src: You came all this way just for that!? At least have a piece of bread, or something...!
The Missing Piece#463.dst: 你大老遠跑這一趟就為了這個！？至少吃塊麵包再走吧……！
The Missing Piece#463.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#464.src: No, no. I couldn't possibly! Duty calls, the post isn't going to sort itself, and all that... Oh, by Her Majesty, the backlog...
The Missing Piece#464.dst: 不不，我怎麼好意思！職責在身，郵件不會自己分好，之類的……喔，天啊，那堆積壓的信……
The Missing Piece#464.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#465.src: Right! You! I hate to admit it, but it seems you've done your job well enough.
The Missing Piece#465.dst: 對了！你！我不想承認，不過看來你這份工作做得還行。
The Missing Piece#465.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#466.src: I happened to double check the records and it seems like my substitute, well, may have been someone else entirely!
The Missing Piece#466.dst: 我剛好又去核對了一下紀錄，看來我那個代班的，嗯，可能根本是另外一個人！
The Missing Piece#466.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#467.src: No harm, no foul, right? The work's already done! No takesies-backsies! Okay?
The Missing Piece#467.dst: 沒造成傷害就不算犯規，對吧？反正工作都做完了！不能反悔喔！好嗎？
The Missing Piece#467.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#469.src: Huh, what was that? I couldn't hear you! Okay, bye!
The Missing Piece#469.dst: 咦，你說什麼？我聽不到！好，掰！
The Missing Piece#469.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#471.src: But it was certainly nice of them to deliver this letter. Let me take a look.
The Missing Piece#471.dst: 不過他特地把這封信送來，人是真的不錯。我來看看。
The Missing Piece#471.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#473.src: Oh, I don't understand... What would she have to apologize for?
The Missing Piece#473.dst: 喔，我不懂……她有什麼好道歉的？
The Missing Piece#473.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#474.src: Please... {u}, take a breath. You're shaking.
The Missing Piece#474.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#476.src: Getting caught in a storm like that... really, I could have waited a few hours! You didn't need to push yourself to get here.
The Missing Piece#476.dst: 淋著那樣的暴雨跑來……真是的，我等個幾小時也沒關係！你不用硬撐著趕過來。
The Missing Piece#476.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#478.src: Yes, I know the weather's bad now... but eventually, it'll get better again. The clouds will clear and the sun will shine again. Right?
The Missing Piece#478.dst: 對，我知道現在天氣很糟……但總會好起來的。雲會散，太陽會再出來。對吧？
The Missing Piece#478.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#480.src: You know, it's not so bad with rain once in a while. Means we don't have to water the flowers, at least! And nothing beats the smell of wet grass after rain, don't you agree?
The Missing Piece#480.dst: 你知道嗎，偶爾下下雨也不壞。至少我們不用去澆花了！而且雨後濕草的味道最棒了，你不覺得嗎？
The Missing Piece#480.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#481.src: We could do something after it clears up. It's been a while since you visited, so why not go to our spot? I should still have some leftover bread lying around...
The Missing Piece#481.dst: 等天氣放晴我們可以做點什麼。你好久沒來了，不如去我們那個老地方？我應該還有剩一些麵包……
The Missing Piece#481.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#482.src: Elise. You're- please, forgive me- you're in danger. I-
The Missing Piece#482.dst: Elise。你——拜託，原諒我——你有危險。我——

The Missing Piece#483.src: I'm in danger? I'm just an ordinary worker, what reason would anyone have to harm me? I'll be fine.
The Missing Piece#483.dst: 我有危險？我只是個普通的工人，誰會有理由要害我？我不會有事的。
The Missing Piece#483.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#484.src: {u}, you're the one pushing herself through this weather, clearly panicking...
The Missing Piece#484.dst: {u}，冒著這種天氣硬撐的人是你，而且明顯在慌張……
The Missing Piece#484.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#485.src: I barely get to see you anymore. And now, out of nowhere, you're here in this state... What's going on? Please, just talk to me.
The Missing Piece#485.dst: 我現在很難得才見得到你。而你突然出現，還是這副樣子……到底怎麼了？拜託，跟我說。
The Missing Piece#485.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#486.src: ...ha. I- I haven't been truthful with you, Elise, and- I can explain later. We need to get out of here, before they-
The Missing Piece#486.dst: ……哈。我——我一直沒對你說實話，Elise，而且——我之後再解釋。我們得離開這裡，趁他們還沒——

The Missing Piece#489.src: Why would they... no, this doesn't make any sense...
The Missing Piece#489.dst: 他們為什麼會……不，這說不通……

The Missing Piece#490.src: Hm. Well, then maybe it's nothing. I'll go see who it is.
The Missing Piece#490.dst: 嗯。那也許沒什麼。我去看看是誰。
The Missing Piece#490.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#491.src: As if one wasn't enough... who could possibly be foolish enough to brave a storm just to come visit this little place? Whatever it is, it can wait.
The Missing Piece#491.dst: 一個還不夠嗎……到底是誰會傻到冒著暴風雨跑來這種小地方？不管是什麼事，都可以等。
The Missing Piece#491.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#494.src: No... No... What are you... Why are you-
The Missing Piece#494.dst: 不……不……你們是要……你們為什麼要——
The Missing Piece#494.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#495.src: Apologies for the disturbance, madam. But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
The Missing Piece#495.dst: 抱歉打擾了，夫人。恐怕我們有公務在身。
The Missing Piece#495.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#497.src: {u}, {u}, why are they here? Why... why won't you answer me...?
The Missing Piece#497.dst: {u}，{u}，他們為什麼會在這裡？為什麼……你為什麼不回答我……？
The Missing Piece#497.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#498.src: What have you done? I... Please, just explain... I- I...
The Missing Piece#498.dst: 你做了什麼？我……拜託，解釋一下……我——我……
The Missing Piece#498.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#499.src: I... how did I overlook this...?
The Missing Piece#499.dst: 我……我怎麼會漏掉這一點……？

The Missing Piece#500.src: Seems you're not quite the strategic mastermind you though yourself, Lioness.
The Missing Piece#500.dst: 看來你也沒有自己以為的那麼足智多謀嘛，母獅。
The Missing Piece#500.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#502.src: Elise... if you... if you just cooperate...
The Missing Piece#502.dst: Elise……如果你……如果你願意配合……

The Missing Piece#503.src: Then... everything will be fine. It... it will.
The Missing Piece#503.dst: 那麼……一切都會沒事的。一定……一定會的。

The Missing Piece#506.src: She... What did she do? Why did she wrap me up in it?
The Missing Piece#506.dst: 她……她做了什麼？她為什麼要把我也牽扯進去？
The Missing Piece#506.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#507.src: Everything I remember... it just leaves me with more questions than answers. Why can't I remember her...? Why!?
The Missing Piece#507.dst: 我想起來的每一件事……都只讓我有更多疑問，沒有答案。我為什麼想不起她……？為什麼！？
The Missing Piece#507.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#508.src: I- I'm just an ordinary factory worker! I woke up early, worked late, slept late... then did it all over again the next day.
The Missing Piece#508.dst: 我——我只是個普通的工廠女工！我早起、晚歸、很晚才睡……然後隔天再重來一遍。
The Missing Piece#508.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#509.src: I've never said a word about the Crown! Why would they possibly care about... me...?
The Missing Piece#509.dst: 我從來沒說過王室半句不是！他們到底為什麼會在意……我……？
The Missing Piece#509.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#510.src: They... they took everything from me. My youth, my body, my time, and... and I never demanded anything in return.
The Missing Piece#510.dst: 他們……他們奪走了我的一切。我的青春、我的身體、我的時間，而……而我從來沒有要求過任何回報。
The Missing Piece#510.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#511.src: So, why... why can't I just have this? This one little thing? Why can't I remember her...?
The Missing Piece#511.dst: 所以，為什麼……為什麼我連這個都不能有？就這麼一件小事？我為什麼不能記得她……？
The Missing Piece#511.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#512.src: ...oh, it might sound sad... but, looking back at it all like this...
The Missing Piece#512.dst: ……唉，這樣講可能有點感傷……不過這樣回頭看下來……
The Missing Piece#512.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#513.src: My life doesn't seem all that great, does it? Ha. Toiling away in a factory for someone else's bread...
The Missing Piece#513.dst: 我這一生好像也沒多精彩，對吧？在工廠裡為別人的麵包耗盡一生……
The Missing Piece#513.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#514.src: But I can feel her. Even if... even if I can't remember her face, or her name, or her touch... I still feel her. Lingering in my heart. Shining.
The Missing Piece#514.dst: 可是我感覺得到她。就算……就算我想不起她的臉、她的名字、她的觸碰……我還是感覺得到她。留在我心裡。發著光。
The Missing Piece#514.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#515.src: ...it's all some sort of sick joke, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#515.dst: ……這一切根本是個惡劣的玩笑，不是嗎？
The Missing Piece#515.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#516.src: They weren't content with all I sacrificed... they had to take even my memories? Is that it...?
The Missing Piece#516.dst: 我犧牲的那些他們還不滿足……連我的記憶都要拿走？是這樣嗎……？
The Missing Piece#516.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#518.src: Wherever you are now... whatever you did... whatever secrets you kept... I hope it was worth it.
The Missing Piece#518.dst: 不管你現在在哪裡……不管你做了什麼……不管你守著什麼秘密……我希望那一切都值得。
The Missing Piece#518.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#519.src: I hope you burn this entire place to the ground.
The Missing Piece#519.dst: 我希望你把這個地方燒個精光。
The Missing Piece#519.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#521.src: I just wish... we could have spent more time together.
The Missing Piece#521.dst: 我只希望……我們能多相處一些時間。
The Missing Piece#521.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#522.src: For a long time, I went along the path that had been laid before me. I did what was right.
The Missing Piece#522.dst: 很長一段時間裡，我都走在別人為我鋪好的路上。我做著所謂正確的事。

The Missing Piece#523.src: But then... I met you, Elise.

The Missing Piece#524.src: I... I don't know what to say, {u}...
The Missing Piece#524.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#527.src: I see... A bird. A pigeon, it's old and gray. Its wings no longer work like they used to...
The Missing Piece#527.dst: 我看到……一隻鳥。一隻鴿子，又老又灰。牠的翅膀已經不像從前那樣了……
The Missing Piece#527.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#528.src: It wants to fly, but it can't... It's struggling...
The Missing Piece#528.dst: 牠想飛，卻飛不起來……牠很吃力……
The Missing Piece#528.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#530.src: No, I can't! It's too sad...
The Missing Piece#530.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#532.src: It's sitting beneath the shade of a canopy, singing. Like a cry, almost, mourning.
The Missing Piece#532.dst: 牠坐在樹蔭底下唱著歌。幾乎像在哭，像在哀悼。
The Missing Piece#532.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#533.src: The clouds, dark clouds are gathering. A storm is coming. The bird is looking around, frantically searching. It's scared.
The Missing Piece#533.dst: 烏雲，濃厚的烏雲正在聚集。暴風雨要來了。那隻鳥四處張望，慌張地找著什麼。牠很害怕。
The Missing Piece#533.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#534.src: It... It calls out, for something... or someone...
The Missing Piece#534.dst: 牠……牠在呼喚著什麼……或是某個人……
The Missing Piece#534.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#535.src: Who is it calling for, Elise?

The Missing Piece#540.src: I won't forget! I won't forget! I won't! I promised! I promised I'd never forget you!
The Missing Piece#540.dst: 我不會忘記！我不會忘記！我不會！我答應過！我答應過我永遠不會忘記你！
The Missing Piece#540.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#543.src: You are an ordinary worker from the Roughworks. You work an ordinary job, and lead an ordinary but solitary life.
The Missing Piece#543.dst: 你是 Roughworks 一名普通的工人。你做著普通的工作，過著普通而孤獨的生活。
The Missing Piece#543.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#545.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#545.dst: 她對你來說什麼都不是。你從未見過她。你也永遠不會見到她。
The Missing Piece#545.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#548.src: You are nothing to her! She is nothing to you! Soon you'll forget she ever existed.
The Missing Piece#548.dst: 你對她來說什麼都不是！她對你來說什麼都不是！你很快就會忘記她曾經存在過。
The Missing Piece#548.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#549.src: No, I will never forget! She was everything to me! She is everything to me! I will never forget her!
The Missing Piece#549.dst: 不，我永遠不會忘記！她曾是我的一切！她現在也是我的一切！我永遠不會忘記她！
The Missing Piece#549.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#551.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#570.speaker: Elise
